title: Larry with his Thompson
description: Larry crouches grinning behind a low sandbag wall, his Thompson submachine gun angled across his chest. Behind him stands a framed screened tent stenciled US — a hooch that, he remembers, was full of rats.
researchNotes: Larry's own identification (Memories comment, 2026-08-15; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0013-c18032231.json). 'My Thompson' — the weapon was his, a period-typical arm for support troops before M16 issue (compare the AR-15 he says he saw for the first time in VN-0029). Same camp construction as the guitar-session series.
